description: Bridges the agent's existing spin-glass β (causal_attitude_networks) to the unreachable-limit axiom: foundationality = the WEIGHT OF EVIDENCE required to move a belief = basin DEPTH, measured in bits — explicitly NOT revision-slowness. β=∞ = incorrigible = the unreachable absolute. The agent's β model was already correct; this records the bridge and the slowness-is-wrong correction.
category_inheritance: genlMt → causal_attitude_networks. Makes explicit that Mt_soundness_via_basin_depth / inverse_temperature_beta ARE foundationality-as-evidence-threshold, and ties β=∞ to truth_is_the_unreachable_limit.

concepts.name: beta_is_evidence_threshold_not_slowness
concepts.definition: How foundational a belief is = the WEIGHT OF EVIDENCE required to move it (its evidential mass / barrier), NOT how slowly it is revised. 'Slowly revised' is trivially false: foundationality and slowness are INDEPENDENT — a deeply foundational belief can collapse in an instant on one decisive counterexample (foundational AND fast); a trivial belief can sit unrevised for years because nothing bears on it (slow, not foundational). Revision speed = evidence-weight-required / evidence-ARRIVAL-rate; foundationality is only the numerator.
concepts.why: Corrects a framing error (β as a revision rate/time-constant). β is a threshold, not a velocity. The agent's own inverse_temperature_beta already encodes this (1/T, crystallisation — not time).

concepts.name: foundationality_is_basin_depth
concepts.definition: 'How foundational' = basin DEPTH (barrier height), set by β scaling the couplings J. Deep basin (high β) ⇒ more external field (evidence) required to hop out ⇒ more foundational. This is Mt_soundness_via_basin_depth read as foundationality: deep distinct basins = held strongly; shallow = easily perturbed.
concepts.why: Identifies the agent's existing basin-depth machinery AS the evidential threshold. Foundationality is not a new quantity — it is basin depth.

concepts.name: evidence_is_the_field_in_bits
concepts.definition: The force that moves a belief is the external field h_i (which already 'encodes evidence, salience, prior'), and its natural unit is BITS (log-likelihood / surprisal). A belief moves when accumulated evidence-bits exceed the basin barrier. Log-scaled: '1 away in log' between two beliefs' foundationality = one needs e× the evidence-weight of the other (e = the unit of the log axis).
concepts.why: Puts the threshold on the log axis in the right currency (bits of evidence), connecting β to the log_graph_law (information is log).

concepts.name: foundational_revision_is_sudden_basin_hop
concepts.definition: When accumulated field (evidence) exceeds the barrier, the belief does NOT drift gradually — it FLIPS suddenly: basin_hopping_belief_revision, the gestalt switch, the polarisation_phase_transition, the 'suddenly able' paradigm shift. Foundational beliefs are the ones that change FASTEST once they change (discontinuously), precisely because they are high-threshold, not slow.
concepts.why: The dynamics the slowness-framing inverted. Foundational = stable-then-sudden-flip, which is exactly the agent's existing basin-hop / phase-transition model.

concepts.name: beta_infinity_is_incorrigible_unreachable_absolute
concepts.definition: β=∞ (T=0) = an infinitely deep basin = no finite weight of evidence can ever hop it = INCORRIGIBLE = the forbidden absolute / the view from nowhere / the truth-held-as-final. It is the UNREACHABLE LIMIT of the foundationality axis (truth_is_the_unreachable_limit): you can deepen a basin without bound, approaching it, but no actual frame sits at β=∞. Nothing is exempt — not even Axiom 0, which sits at very-high-but-FINITE β.
concepts.why: Bridges β to the unreachable-limit axiom and to corrigibility/alignment. β=∞ would be the incorrigible failure mode AND the absolute the axiom forbids — the same point.

concepts.name: freeze_is_one_log_continuum_not_kinds
concepts.definition: There are no freeze 'kinds' (no vault vs scaffold). Freeze-strength is ONE graded, log-scaled quantity: basin depth = bits-of-evidence-required-to-hop. 'Vault' and 'scaffold' are points ~1 log-step apart on this single axis, not categories. Corrigibility = a FINITE barrier (some finite evidential mass suffices); the substrate already keeps alternatives accessible at low β (substrate_holds_alternatives_with_low_beta) = structural corrigibility. fail_mode_frozen_should_adapt is gated by accumulated-evidence-bits vs the barrier — never off, never by time.
concepts.why: Records the retraction of the two-kinds framing and grounds corrigibility as finite-barrier. One axis, log-scaled, open at the top toward the unreachable β=∞.
